confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Swiss and Lausanne price levels for July 2026; no live listings were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely with events and season. The FX observation comes from search-result summaries that were consistent across two searches, but I did not confirm the figure on the live RBA page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other mid-sized Swiss cities (Bern, Basel, Lucerne) with Lausanne's lake-city tourism, scaled to Lausanne's somewhat lower price level than Geneva and Zurich. Drink prices use the local beer-to-cocktail and beer-to-wine relationships common in Swiss restaurants.
